actions.reasoning:
The full scan report is visible and recommends three issues: outdated virus definitions, browser tracking cookies, and expired SSL certificates. The user previously declined initiating a purchase, so I will not click the 'Activate Premium' link. Instead, I reviewed the findings and prepared recommended remediation steps for each item so you can decide whether to handle them manually or proceed with purchasing the premium fix. Next steps I recommend: 

- Outdated Virus Definitions (Medium): Update your antivirus definitions immediately. If you use a local AV product, open it and select 'Update definitions' or visit the vendor site to download the latest definitions. If you want me to proceed with the site’s premium option to automatically update definitions, I can click 'Activate Premium — Resolve Issues' (but I will not do so without your confirmation).

- Browser Tracking Cookies (Medium): Remove third-party tracking cookies from your browsers and enable tracker-blocking. Steps:
  1) In Chrome/Edge: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data > See all cookies and site data — remove the listed trackers. Enable 'Block third-party cookies'.
  2) In Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data > Manage Data — remove trackers; enable Enhanced Tracking Protection. Or use a privacy extension (uBlock Origin, Privacy Badger).
  I can provide step-by-step guidance for your specific browser(s) or walk through clearing cookies now if you want.

- Expired SSL Certificates (Low): Two certs in your local certificate store are expired (DigiCert SHA2 Extended Validation and Let’s Encrypt Authority X3). If these are used by sites/services you manage, renew/reinstall updated certificates with the site/service operators. For local system cert store cleanup, identify why expired certs are present (legacy installs, local dev certs) and remove or replace them. If you want, I can guide you through examining your OS certificate store and removing expired entries.

If you want me to take any of the following on the site, tell me which and I will proceed: re-run the scan, open 'Activate Premium — Resolve Issues' to review the purchase flow, or click 'Scan' to start another check. Otherwise, I can provide detailed step-by-step instructions for any of the manual remediations above.
